results.fact: Whether the scramble goes via Headlee Pass or up the South Fork Stillaguamish drainage
results.correct_value: South Fork Stillaguamish drainage to the southeast-ridge notch (the South Ridge line), not over Headlee Pass
results.evidence: The Mountaineers South Ridge description and a 2015 trip report both leave the Sunrise Mine Trail ~0.5 mi in and go up the South Fork Stillaguamish drainage to a notch in the southeast ridge; neither crosses Headlee Pass. The only Headlee-side line found (the SummitPost peak page's Northwest Face/North Ridge) leaves the trail at the BASE of the switchbacks below the pass, not at the pass, with ~50 ft of class 4 - so the itinerary's 'climb to Headlee Pass, then traverse' and approach_variants' 'do NOT leave the trail lower down' match no source. Fixing it means rewriting the itinerary schedule, timing note, approach_variants and several hazard/gear lines with new times and mileages that no source states, so it is left for an owner rewrite rather than patched.

results.evidence: The summit waypoint's 16.92 mi (tagged distFrom: track) is still inconsistent with the row: the waypoint chain reaches the gully below the summit at 7.5 mi, while the itinerary (10.5 mi to a treeline camp plus a 3-mi round-trip summit day), totalNote (~24 mi round trip) and dist_km (19.31 km = 12 mi) imply roughly 12 mi one way. Route descriptions of the Little Giant Pass / Napeequa approach and multi-peak trip reports on this ridge describe the line but give only loop totals (e.g. a 40-mile multi-peak trip), never a one-way distance to Berge's summit, and a figure derived from the itinerary would be a computed value. No patch; the waypoint chain's own distances also look inconsistent with the itinerary and should be reviewed with the pins.

[Held: sources split 5.5 / 5.6 / 5.7.] Two independent sources grade the summit rock at 5.5: the route database gives the final summit as one pitch of 5.5 with fixed protection, and a full north-to-south Pickets traverse report lists Challenger as a class 2 glacier with 50 ft of 5.5 rock to the summit.
